pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark, irregularly shaped polygons with jagged, high-frequency edge gradients. Individual regions exhibit high spatial area coverage with sharp pixel transitions at the boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Thin, light-colored topological network with frequent tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Inter-patch spacing is narrow, continuous, and exhibits uniform thickness across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine, low-amplitude serrated profile visible along the dorsal neck line; presents as a continuous dark fringe with high-frequency irregularities against the sky.
